bio: Haymarket Hotel is situated on the corner of Haymarket and Suffolk Place in the heart of London's theatre district. It is next door to the famous Haymarket Theatre Royal and is surrounded by some of London's best restaurants and bars.  Enjoy the Brumus Afternoon Tea. Featuring an array of delicious seasonal treats including butternut squash, smoked cheddar and pumpkin seed Croque Monsieur and a Banoffee tart with dulce de leche.  The hotel is perfect for Mayfair, Regent Street and Jermyn Street shopping. Trafalgar Square and the National Gallery are just around the corner - St. James's Park is a short walk. The hotel is within easy reach of the city's financial centre.  Afternoon Tea is served in the chic Brumus Bar and Restaurant where you can enjoy a selection of classic Afternoon Tea sandwiches, an array of delicious cakes, along with freshly baked scones with clotted cream and preserves. You also have the option to indulge in a glass of Champagne.  Please note that each guest dining must order Afternoon Tea. One Afternoon Tea cannot be shared between two or more guests.
